data.profile_summary: A student at Hong Kong Polytechnic University studying Generative AI and Humanities, they plan to travel post-graduation, especially to climb Mount Fuji. They enjoy rewatching movies for deeper insights, playing the guzheng, and prefer instrumental music and sci-fi films. A night owl who dislikes open-world games, they value nature, mindfulness activities like rock climbing, and managing stress while studying abroad.
